blocks.text: WSJ：马斯克希望围绕AI将一家估值2万亿美元的火箭公司与一家估值1.5万亿美元的汽车制造商合并。

inlines.text: WSJ：马斯克希望围绕AI将一家估值2万亿美元的火箭公司与一家估值1.5万亿美元的汽车制造商合并。

blocks.text: SpaceX的AI部门现已成为其最大业务，第三季度营收为75.6亿美元，而去年同期为8.13亿美元；其196亿美元季度资本支出中，超过164亿美元流向了AI。

inlines.text: SpaceX的AI部门现已成为其最大业务，第三季度营收为75.6亿美元，而去年同期为8.13亿美元；其196亿美元季度资本支出中，超过164亿美元流向了AI。

blocks.text: 这一增长使SpaceX从10.5亿美元亏损转为44亿美元季度盈利，使其具备财务实力去吸收特斯拉，而非反过来。

blocks.text: 支持合并的AI逻辑将特斯拉的Robotaxi和Optimus机器人视为前端，将SpaceX的数据中心和卫星链路视为它们所依赖的基础设施。

blocks.text: WSJ: Musk wants to combine a $2T rocket company with a $1.5T carmaker around AI.

blocks.text: SpaceX’s AI unit is now its largest business, with third-quarter revenue of $7.56B against $813M a year earlier, and more than $16.4B of its $19.6B quarterly capital spending went to AI.

blocks.text: That growth turned SpaceX to a $4.4B quarterly profit from a $1.05B loss, giving it the financial weight to absorb Tesla rather than the reverse.

blocks.text: The AI case for the merger treats Tesla’s robotaxis and Optimus robots as the front end and SpaceX’s data centers and satellite links as the infrastructure they would depend on.
